odia: ଶାହି ଶାହି ହୋଇ ବୁଲଇ ଗୋରସ, ମଦ ବିକାଯାଏ ବସି
title: One goes round, one stays put
literal_meaning: Milk goes from neighbourhood to neighbourhood; liquor is sold while sitting.
explanation: Movement belongs to the milk; sitting belongs to the liquor sale. The contrast makes unequal selling effort visible. Our reading uses that imbalance to ask why one offering must seek attention while another receives it. The source does not explain the difference or supply evidence about actual demand.
meaning_odia: ବୁଲିବାଟି ଗୋରସ ସହ, ବସି ବିକିବାଟି ମଦ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ବିକ୍ରିର ଦୁଇ ଭିନ୍ନ ପରିଶ୍ରମ ଏହି ବିରୋଧରେ ଦିଶେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଉଠେ—ଗୋଟିଏ ଜିନିଷକୁ ଧ୍ୟାନ ପାଇବାକୁ ଖୋଜି ବୁଲିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ୁଛି, ଅନ୍ୟଟି ପାଖକୁ ଲୋକ ଆସୁଛନ୍ତି କାହିଁକି? ଏହି କାରଣ ବା ପ୍ରକୃତ ଚାହିଦାର ତଥ୍ୟ ଉତ୍ସ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
english_summary: Contrasting selling effort prompts our question about uneven attention.
odia_summary: ବିକ୍ରିର ଭିନ୍ନ ପରିଶ୍ରମରେ ଅସମାନ ଧ୍ୟାନକୁ ନେଇ ଆମ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ପଢ଼ାଚକ୍ର ପାଇଁ ନିମନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ନେଇ ସଦସ୍ୟମାନେ ଘରେ ଘରେ ଯାଉଥିଲେ। ପାଖରେ ଏକ ଖେଳ ପ୍ରତିଯୋଗିତାକୁ ଲୋକ ନିଜେ ଆସୁଥିଲେ। ଜଣେ ଢଗଟି ମନେ ପକାଇ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଆମ ନିମନ୍ତ୍ରଣରେ କଣ ବଦଳାଇବା?” / Reading-group members deliver invitations door to door while a nearby game attracts visitors on its own. One recalls the line and asks, “What should we change in our invitation?” This comparison is invented, not a ranking of the activities.
cultural_context: The dictionary defines the repeated neighbourhood expression, not a historical trading custom. No virtue ranking, universal consumer preference or health claim is inferred.
